Sebastian Muller — Senior Product Manager at SentinelX Cybersecurity  
8 years of experience shaping secure, user-centric solutions in high-stakes environments.  

Focused on building products that bridge technical complexity with real-world impact. My work blends deep domain knowledge with a pragmatic approach to solving problems that matter.  

In cybersecurity, product decisions often mean the difference between risk and resilience. I’ve led cross-functional teams to design solutions that meet evolving threats while maintaining usability. Recent projects included refining detection platforms for enterprise clients and streamlining incident response workflows.  

Collaboration is key. Whether aligning with engineering, security analysts, or executive stakeholders, I prioritize clarity and alignment to drive outcomes. Agile frameworks guide my process, but results speak louder than methodology.  

Skills:  
- Competitive analysis (shaping product strategy through market insights)  
- Roadmap planning (prioritizing features with technical and business alignment)  
- Agile/Scrum (scaling delivery frameworks to support global teams)  
- Product management (owning end-to-end lifecycle from concept to market)  
- Stakeholder management (translating diverse needs into cohesive roadmaps)  
- Cybersecurity fundamentals (threat modeling, incident response, compliance)  
- Tools: Jira, Confluence, Figma, SQL, CI/CD pipelines  

Driven by practical outcomes, not buzzwords. Let’s build better defenses — together.
